content.text: Great instinct — concrete output sells this better than prose. Plan: real (not mocked) captures — a viz screenshot into `example/viz.png`, plus a `TOUR.md` with actual `sun log` / `sun show` / refs output, and the README gets the screenshot up top + a link to the tour. content.text: Capture files landed inside the repo and polluted the log — redoing with the output dir outside and `show` aimed at the agent turn commit:

input.command:
S=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-bmo-sun/03b842fc-7029-49f7-afcc-ad7e2d3a1aea/scratchpad && cd $S/tour/repo && export SUN_PROJECTS=$S/tour/projects && SUN=/Users/bmo/sun/sun.py && OUT=$S/tour/out && mkdir -p $OUT && rm -rf out &&
git reset -q --hard HEAD~2 && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
evs = [json.loads(l) for l in open(".git/sun/events.jsonl")]
keep = [e for e in evs if "out/log.txt" not in json.dumps(e)]
open(".git/sun/events.jsonl","w").write("".join(json.dumps(e)+"\n" for e in keep))
EOF
printf 'export const app = () => login("belinda");\n' > src/app.ts && python3 $SUN sync >/dev/null &&
TURN=$(git log --pretty='%H %s' | awk '/turn 1/{print $1}') &&
python3 $SUN log > $OUT/log.txt && python3 $SUN show $TURN > $OUT/show.txt &&
git for-each-ref refs/sun > $OUT/refs.txt && git ls-tree refs/sun/sessions/belinda/9f2b41aa-7c33-4e08-b1d4-2a9c55e0f817 > $OUT/lstree.txt &&
python3 $SUN sessions > $OUT/sessions.txt && python3 $SUN viz -o $OUT/viz.html >/dev/null &&
cat $OUT/log.txt && echo ---- && sed -n 1,60p $OUT/show.txt

content.text: Captures are clean. Now the screenshot — rendering the demo viz headless, selecting an agent commit so the detail pane shows the event + patch:

input.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
import os
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.launch()
    pg = b.new_page(viewport={"width": 1180, "height": 620}, device_scale_factor=2)
    pg.goto("file://" + os.path.abspath("example/demo.html"))
    # select the agent turn commit so the right pane shows its event + patch
    pg.locator("#c li", has_text="turn 1").first.click()
    pg.wait_for_timeout(100)
    pg.screenshot(path="example/viz.png")
    b.close()
print("saved", os.path.getsize("example/viz.png"), "bytes")
EOF
